root_motivation: Who: Joe and the controller reading the PMF line. What: a count of real external users they can act on. Why not today: classify_source_class returns External by elimination, so 16 prod signups from carbon's unstamped refresh scripts on 2026-10-20 read as external and the line is untrustworthy. Fix: external must be earned by positive evidence (verified claim e-mail or a later-UTC-day return); the default becomes unattributed.
user_persona: The PM reading status sees external N (claimed a, returned r), unattributed u, synthetic s and knows which number is a user; the controller reads tenants_confirmed from healthz; an operator who forgets the synthetic header lands in unattributed, not in the user count.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a signup from a non-loopback, non-fleet IP with no X-Mcphost-Synthetic header, When the tenant row is written, Then origin='unattributed', origin_detail='no-positive-evidence' and healthz tenants_by_origin.unattributed rises by one.

Given an unattributed tenant, When its claim e-mail is verified, Then origin='external', origin_detail='claimed-email' and exactly one admin_audit origin_promoted row exists even when two verifications race (single-row UPDATE ... WHERE origin='unattributed').

Given an unattributed tenant with no fleet-IP or header-stamped call in its history, When it makes a clean authenticated call on a later UTC date and >= 21,600 s after creation, Then origin='external' with detail returned:<n>d and the audit row carries the IP hash; midnight-crossing, fleet, stamped or tainted histories never promote.

Given a synthetic tenant, When a claim is verified or a qualifying later-day call arrives, Then origin stays synthetic, no origin_promoted audit row is written and synthetic_promotion_refused increments and is readable in healthz.

Given one seeded tenant per case, When the migration runs, Then verified external becomes external/claimed-email, unverified external rows become unattributed/legacy-external-unverified, unclassified becomes unattributed/legacy-unclassified, synthetic is unchanged, no row is NULL and the journaled before/after counts sum equally.

Given an empty DB and a seeded DB, When healthz, mcphost funnel --json, admin funnel and scripts/ops/origin-counts.py are read, Then they report identical tenants_by_origin, external_by_evidence, tenants_real, tenants_confirmed and origin_unknown keys with the stated identities, and the script equals healthz.

Given the single Origin enum, When the generated-contract test runs, Then backfill, healthz and funnel value lists derive from Origin::as_str at compile time, the test fails on any extra or missing value, and each migration's SQL stays a static string.

Given prod after deploy, When the operator runs scripts/ops/origin-counts.py on mcphost-1 as a counts-only ro read, Then it prints the counts line with n == a + b and the totals equal the pre-deploy tenant count (Live; deferred, operator-provisioned).
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred -- operator-provisioned: the script run on mcphost-1 sourcing /etc/mcphost/env, pasted into the run note.

scope: src/state.rs: the Origin enum (one macro-generated list), derive_origin -> unattributed, return_promotion_days.
src/db.rs: promote_origin_row (single-row UPDATE + audit), observe_call_origin, origin_report, migrations 0135 (taint column + origin_counters) and 0136 (one-shot journaled backfill).
src/handler.rs, src/http.rs, src/admin.rs, src/main.rs: call-path observation and the shared origin keys; scripts/ops/origin-counts.py.
non_goals: Offboarding or deleting any tenant; changing what counts as synthetic; a UI; rotating keys; changing signup rate limits; deciding whether returned counts toward PMF.

additional.no_table_rebuild: No CHECK constraint and no DEFAULT change on origin (a rebuild of tenants, signup_events and calls); new code always writes origin explicitly.

five_whys_trace.q: Why did 16 fleet signups read as external?
five_whys_trace.a: Scripts called prod raw, no header, from a hotspot IP outside MCPHOST_FLEET_IPS.
classify_source_class returns External when nothing matches, and derive_origin wrote external for every non-synthetic row.
An allowlist of what is ours can never be complete; external must require positive evidence.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Does returned count toward the PMF line?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: No: tenants_confirmed is claimed-email only; returned is exposed separately.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Where is fleet/stamped call history kept, since calls has no ip_class?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: tenants.origin_taint_unix, stamped on the authenticated call path while the tenant is unattributed.
